results.excerpt: Rate limit incident Q3 2024: API consumers were not warned 24 hours before the rate limit threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute. Several clients experienced outages lasting 2-4 hours.
Lessons learned: (1) All limit changes require 72-hour advance notice. (2) Clients must have a documented escalation path. (3) Rate limit headers should be included in all API responses.

output_document.summary: During Q3 2024, an API rate limit change from 1000 to 500 requests per minute was deployed without proper client notification, causing 2-4 hour outages for several clients. The postmortem identified three critical lessons: (1) all limit changes require 72-hour advance notice to prevent disruptions, (2) clients need a documented escalation path for support, and (3) rate limit headers must be included in all API responses to help clients monitor their usage proactively. These lessons should inform the new webhooks feature design by ensuring notification mechanisms, clear communication protocols, and transparent rate limit visibility are built in from the start.
